administration.note: Kirklees has no Leader and no Cabinet. After the 7 May 2026 election the council is in no overall control: Reform UK is the largest group with 29 of 69 seats (group leader Cllr Sarah Wood), Green 12, Conservative 9, Kirklees Independent Group 9, Liberal Democrat 5, Valley Independent Group 3, Independent 2. Two leadership votes failed (20 and 28 May 2026; the Conservatives declined to back either the Reform or the Green candidate). The Chief Executive (Steve Mawson) runs the council on interim delegated powers and further leadership votes are expected. Labour lost all 23 of its seats.

mtfs.intervention_status: None (no S114, no Exceptional Financial Support, no Best Value Notice; positive Section 25 assurance). The key financial risk is the DSG High Needs deficit (GBP 81.3m at Q3 2025/26) and the statutory override ending 31 March 2028.
mtfs._source: Kirklees 2026/27 budget pack (s68291, verified) + the directorate DSG investigation

reform_group.note: Reform UK is the largest group but has not formed an administration. The AI DOGE directorate platform supports the group both as the would-be administration (government-readiness) and as the largest scrutiny group while officers run the council.
